title: tiling.toml
description:
How Panes stand: the Flow, the widths, and rules by kind of Pane. A
key, an Agent and banda get the same answer.

flow.description:
Where a Pane opens. Solo here is the start for a device that has
not chosen: its key and the Flow on the bar turn it on one device.

columns.description:
A column's widths and a Pane's heights. `[columns]` in look.toml
before ADR 0127 (grace).

rule.description:
Rules by kind of Pane, each a table named by the kind:
`[rule.terminal.terminal]` is the rule of `terminal.terminal`.

Flow.description:
How an Agent's windows stand, its Flow (ADR 0079): where its Thread
opens, and what a pick of it shows.

oneOf.description:
Where the window has it: beside the Pane in front, and a pick goes
to wherever its Pane is. `off` before ADR 0079 (grace).

Each Project on its own workspace, its Agents in a row, a pick at
the left (ADR 0065, ADR 0102). `project` before ADR 0079, `space`
before ADR 0069 (grace).

The row, and a device that has not chosen starts in Solo: what
has the focus fills the screen (ADR 0102). Each device turns Solo
on and off for itself.

WidthsSettings.description:
A column's widths and a Pane's heights, the Tiling's: `[columns]` in
`tiling.toml`. One for every device: a width is a share of the screen.

default.title: New column
default.description: Where its Pane does not ask for its own.

alone.title: A column alone
alone.description: Until a second opens beside it: then both take a new column's.

presets.title: Steps
presets.description: The widths the keys that widen and narrow a column go through.

heights.description: A Pane's steps in its column, as shares of it.

display.title: A column shows
display.description:
Its Panes one above another, or as a Deck: one at a time, the
others' names over it.

Display.description: How a column shows its Panes.

oneOf.description: One above another, sharing the column's height.

A Deck: one at a time, the others' names in a row over it, as niri's
tabbed column (ADR 0065).

RuleSettings.description:
A rule for one kind of Pane, as the file says it. Every key is
optional: what a rule leaves out is as the kind's App and the Flow say.

width.description:
A new column's width for a Pane of this kind: a share of the
screen, such as "1/3", or "1" for all of it.

opens.description:
Where a Pane of this kind opens when no one named a place: "beside",
right of the Pane in front; "below", under it, in its column;
"group", in its Group; or "project", last on its Project's
workspace, in the row. With no Pane in front, and in the row from a
workspace of another Project, it opens as the Flow says.

Opens.description:
Where a Pane opens when no one named a place, as a rule of its kind
says. Each is a place `placing` gives already: a rule chooses among
them, by the Pane in front.

oneOf.description: Right of the Pane in front, in a column of its own.
Under the Pane in front, in its column.

In the Group of the Pane in front, which starts one when it is in
none (ADR 0065).

Last on its Project's workspace, in the row, as a Thread opens (ADR
0102).
